# EditWitness

> Local, explicit observability counterexamples for CRISPR validation assays.
> Research alpha; software-tested, not empirically validated.

## Start here
- README.md: installation, synthetic example, supported scope.
- docs/agent-guide.md: machine interface and interpretation rules.
- docs/scientific-model.md: exact observation model and limitations.
- docs/data-contract.md: coordinates, invariants, schema and outputs.
- AGENTS.md: development invariants and continuation commands.
- roadmap.json: machine-readable implementation and validation tasks.
- BUILD_STATUS.md: checks actually performed on the delivered artifact.

This file is a navigation aid, not an assurance of automatic agent discovery.
